Package sebastian

Class ScrabbleFunctionality

java.lang.Object
sebastian.ScrabbleFunctionality
public class ScrabbleFunctionality extends Object
Class that holds the functions for the Scrabble combination application class. Methods recursively loop through the letters to find and display all combinations.

    • runScript

      public void runScript(JTextField thisInputArea, JTextArea thisOutputTextArea, List<String> thisCombinations, int wordLength)
      Runs the scrabble combination generation script. Grabs the input and recursively generates all of the combinations before displaying them to the output text area.
      Parameters:
      thisInputArea - the text field with the input word
      thisOutputTextArea - the text area where the output will be displayed
      thisCombinations - list of combinations
      wordLength - determines the length of the word you want to be put in, has to be that exact amount
